About.title: About Us
About.body: From strategy and design to development and launch — we deliver end-to-end digital solutions tailored to your goals. Our team builds reliable technologies and intuitive interfaces that bring real value to both users and businesses.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.content: We build technology that solves real problems for businesses and people. Our mission is to deliver end-to-end digital solutions with clarity, reliability, and measurable impact.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.content: We see a future where complex operations are transparent, data-driven, and humane. We work with organizations to modernize systems without losing sight of the people who use them every day.

process.title: Our process
process.content: Discovery, design, build, ship, and improve — in tight feedback loops with stakeholders. We align on outcomes early, prototype quickly, and keep quality high through review, testing, and observability.

culture.title: Our culture
culture.content: We value ownership, direct communication, and continuous learning. Teams collaborate across time zones with shared standards and respect for craft.

technologies.title: Our technologies
technologies.content: We work with modern web stacks, cloud infrastructure, IoT and data pipelines, and AI where it genuinely helps — always chosen for fit, not hype.

values.title: Our values
values.content: Integrity, quality, and long-term partnerships. We say what we mean, ship what we promise, and invest in relationships that outlast individual projects.

Careers.title: Be part of our mission
Careers.text: At Hebent Tech, we believe that great work starts with great people. We're always looking for passionate, talented, and driven individuals who want to make an impact, grow professionally, and contribute to something meaningful.

CookiesPolicy.description: At Hebent  Tech, we use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences and understand how you interact with our website.
CookiesPolicy.what: What types of cookies do we use?

categories.title: Essential Cookies:
categories.description: Necessary for the website to function properly, enabling basic features like page navigation and access to secure areas. Performance Cookies: Collect information about how visitors use our site, helping us improve speed and usability.

categories.title: Functional Cookies:
categories.description: Remember your preferences and settings to provide a more personalized experience.

categories.title: Advertising Cookies:
categories.description: Used to deliver relevant ads based on your interests and to measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns.

PrivacyPolicy.description1: At Hebent Tech, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect the personal information you provide to us when you use our website
PrivacyPolicy.description2: We may collect the following types of information:

items1.title: Personal Information:
items1.description: When you contact us, apply for a job, or use our services, you may provide personal details such as your name, email address, phone number, or resume.

items1.title: Usage Data:
items1.description: We may collect data about how you interact with our website, including IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent on pages, and referring websites.

items1.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies:
items1.description: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience, analyze usage patterns, and personalize content. You can control cookie preferences in your browser settings.

items2.description: Communicate with you (e.g., responses, updates, newsletters)
Analyze website performance and user behavior

PrivacyPolicy.span: We will never sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
